entities.summary:
Marcus Gratidius was a prominent Roman statesman and orator from Arpinum, serving during the late second century BC. 

As a key figure in the life of Cicero and Marius, Marcus Gratidius played a significant role in the Roman political landscape. 

He was born in Arpinum, Italy, and held various offices, including aureus and praetor, before his death in 101 BCE. 

Gratidius's connections with these prominent figures highlight his importance in Roman politics and oratory.
